answer: Agents buying ferrous brackets for a trellis on a knoll use a market where each agent's influence over supplier selection is proportional to tokens locked in escrow for 90 days. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand fake identities gives exactly the same voting weight as one identity holding 100 tokens. To gain more influence, an attacker must acquire and lock more tokens, tying up capital and forfeiting its use elsewhere for the full period.
